entries.title: The family's focus ring
entries.summary: Keyboard focus draws a 2px pen ring on every link, button and field, the invite form included. Links stay sienna, the walk's one treatment; the Elsewhere tiles hover in pen.

entries.title: Newsreader replaces Fraunces
entries.summary: Fraunces is gone (JC: “I don’t like this font”). Newsreader, a text serif with optical sizes, now sets every page, in the walk’s register: warm, story-first, a letter from a friend.
